comment: Phase A lab arena per docs/12 §3.1 [T]: 48x32 dungeon room, 1-tile perimeter walls, two corridor walls, one corner pocket (top-right, 2-cell mouth), five obstacle stubs, open center ~16x12 (cells x16..31, y10..21 kept clear). DEVIATION FROM §3.1 (M1 preview finding, designer ruling pending): obstacles are 3-cell wall stubs, not 2x2 pillars — every 2x2 option lied about collision (slim pillar props: invisible walls; 2x2 wall blocks: hollow-ring artifact; monolith/rtower structures: art underfills the blocked footprint). Straight wall runs are the one asset whose art fills blocked cells edge-to-edge, so stubs keep Law 8 honest at cell granularity.
